LanguageData.LP_Sub_DivineSoul.label: Divine Soul
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DivineSoul.description: Divine grace flows in the bloodline: knows the cleric's cure wounds, picks a divine affinity (light, twilight, protection), regains mana faster when meditating or praying, becomes an angel, and finally heals themself when falling and calls down a miracle.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DivineSoul.choices.0.label: divine affinity
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DivineSoul.choices.0.tips.0: Healing from sorcerers and divine magic +25%.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DivineSoul.choices.0.tips.1: Sorcerer spell damage against the living (fleshy creatures) +20%.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_DivineSoul.choices.0.tips.2: Each sorcerer spell cast gives yourself a shield absorbing 8 damage (1 hour, doesn't stack, refreshes).
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ShadowMagic.label: Shadow Magic
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ShadowMagic.description: A sorcerer born in darkness: sees in the dark, casts stronger spells in darkness, holds on without falling, summons a hound of ill omen to hunt enemies, teleports between dark places, and finally takes umbral form. "Darkness" = cells with under 30% light.
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ClockworkSoul.label: Clockwork Soul
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ClockworkSoul.description: The order of the clockwork plane flows into the bloodline: re-rolls failed saves for teammates, repairs machines faster, wraps teammates in shields of order, unfolds a clockwork cavalcade, and finally summons order constructs; wild surge's wild magic no longer has bad results.
